//3: Never put a token itself in here — only a reference to where it lives.
//4: Every key is optional: with no config at all the skill discovers the tracker
//5: from the project and runs with the defaults shown below.
//6: The older ~/.agents/skill-config/orchestrate/ location is still read, at lower
//7: precedence, so an existing setup keeps working. See standards/agent-config.md.
//tracker: Where work packages are tracked. kind is one of: file, tasknotes, github, jira, linear. Only github/jira/linear need a credential.

tracker.//path: file | tasknotes — repo-relative path to the tracker file, or the task folder for tasknotes.
tracker.//github: kind=github — the issue repo. Auth falls back to the gh CLI when credentials.githubToken is absent.
tracker.//jira: kind=jira — site host, project key, and the Atlassian account email the token belongs to.
tracker.//labels: Applied to every package entry the orchestrator creates. Arrays replace wholesale across layers.

//questions: Where question documents collect, and who answers them. path is relative to the work, not the repo root.
//models: Package tiering. Judgment-heavy drafting goes to the stronger model; mechanical work to the cheaper one. Omit to inherit the session model.
//defaults: Tunables. Shown values are the built-in defaults.
//credentials: Only needed for a remote tracker. Pick ONE source per credential.

githubToken.//cacheVar: Optional, works with any source. When this variable holds a non-empty value it is used and the source is never touched — one Touch ID prompt per shell session instead of one per process. Seed it with: export GITHUB_TOKEN="$(op read 'op://Vault/GitHub token/credential')". Name it what the env source below uses, so switching between them is a source edit and not a rename.

credentials.//alternatives: Replace the object above with any one of these (each also accepts cacheVar):
credentials.//jiraToken: kind=jira — an Atlassian API token, paired with tracker.email.
credentials.//linearToken: kind=linear — a Linear personal API key.
